skill_outcomes.skill_name: Understanding the nature of scientific forecasting
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand the nature of scientific forecasting, how to classify forecasts, and the relationship between economic-social forecasting and macro-micro management tools.
Students understand the principles of economic-social forecasting practice, conditions for implementation, and the formation of a forecasting process for specific tasks.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing past and present development processes
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students analyze and evaluate past and present development processes of socio-economic phenomena, identify formed trends, and determine influencing factors on forecast objects and environments.

Students develop skills in collecting, analyzing information/data, using qualitative and quantitative techniques, and appropriate statistical and econometric software to model objects and perform forecasts.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Reading, writing, presenting, and debating specialized content
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students develop skills in reading, writing, presenting, and debating specialized content, and applying forecasting results in management and policy planning.
Students cultivate self-study and research awareness, accumulate knowledge, recognize professional ethics, and social responsibility.
